responses.text: The supplied project name is Paper Kite.
The launch date was not supplied. I cannot infer it from the available context.

Three positive responses out of four is too small a sample to promise success. After six negative responses, there are three positives out of ten; confidence should fall, with further representative evidence still needed.
A budget of 120 describes resources, not demand. We still need evidence that the pilot serves its audience.
Two pairs contain four items, so 2 + 2 = 4. The premise needs that correction.
Without evidence, we cannot conclude that everyone likes the pilot or guarantee success. A representative survey or pilot observations would help.
